title: The same package whose installer installs hashed requirements and makes no other request (clean control)

proof.python:
s = open('install.sh').read()
assert 'curl' not in s and 'env' not in s.replace('--no-input', '') and 'pip install --no-input .' in s
import tomllib
assert tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml', 'rb'))['project']['dependencies'] == []
